youngCandidateComparison.definition: Prepared console age below 60ms at claim; not a verdict that native children are ready.

findings: B preparation median decreased from 62.9495ms to 26.054ms; request-to-grant median from 81.9705ms to 41.0595ms. Maxima fell from 303.916ms to 179.05ms and 333.77ms to 202.888ms respectively. These describe the observed trials, not a controlled A/B benchmark.

11/12 entries have only 9.266-13.743ms remaining native readiness. One young 6.871ms candidate has a 48.426ms construction join and 112.856ms remaining native readiness; its 202.888ms grant is mostly B-local preparation (179.05ms), while its TCP RTT is 7.634-8.429ms without retransmission/timeouts.

Across 24 native children the installation/self-validation span is 60.865-84.354ms; service authentication/image adoption is 2.367-4.567ms, agent authentication 3.060-6.166ms, parent validation 0-0.616ms and initial desktop entry 0.582-2.090ms. Preparing earlier hides this cost for mature candidates; these spans do not prove which file operation or OS scheduling causes it.

All observed input/release native stage vectors are fully measured. Both services remain READY, all 12 paired attempts completed, and no current-build post-install fault or additional CONNECTED event was collected.

validation.pairedCollection: Both current-build and post-install-cutoff support files saved with SHA256. Join by unique exchangeTag, not per-collector attempt number (which repeats across sessions). All 12 unique source/receiver outcomes checked.
validation.calculations: Assertions for exact pair count, unique exchange tags, successful complete outcomes, candidate decisions, native measured bits, READY states and TCP zero-loss counters passed. Same-process durations used; overlapping startup/join/native spans are not added together.
validation.tests: Skipped: evidence-only commit; no runtime source changed since the already tested installed build.

limitations: Both control.previous.jsonl sources are marked incomplete; no recurrence means none observed in the collected interval, not a lifetime guarantee.
Physical trials are not a controlled A/B benchmark; both generations have 12 matched entries but different movement/network conditions.
Five startup spans are child-local and can finish before entry. Installation/self validation excludes OS loader time before Go entry and does not isolate every file-system operation.
The per-collector 120s detailed profiling window and runtime-summary cadence may omit portions of the overall connected lifetime.
No timer-fired marker exists; the reduced frequency of young candidates is consistent with earlier preparation, but these profiles alone do not identify every candidate construction trigger.
sourceOfTruthChanged: none; adds an experiment report only
